anomalies.observed: NFC_INT contains the FD pin (U3.4) and the antenna terminal LA (U3.1), plus A1.2, C18.1 and R3.1. C18 ties this merged net to the other antenna terminal net Net-(A1-A).
anomalies.expected: NFC_INT should be only the field-detect net (U2.22, R3.1, U3.4); U3.1/A1.2 should be on a separate antenna terminal net, with C18 across the two antenna terminals.

evidence.quote: NFC_INT net: U2 pin 22 (PA6) — R3 (10 kΩ) to VCC — U3 pin 4 (FD)

anomalies.impact: The open-drain field-detect line and MCU GPIO are shorted to an NFC antenna terminal; the 10k pull-up biases the coil, detunes the antenna and prevents reliable field detection.

anomalies.observed: U4 pin 28 (VCC, power_in) is connected only to C7 pin 1; C7 pin 2 is GND. U4 pin 28 is not in the global VCC net, which contains U4 pins 6, 9 and 11.
anomalies.expected: The SSD1306 VCC supply pin should be connected to the board VCC rail, with C7 bypassing that supply pin to GND.

evidence.quote: C7 (2.2 µF) — U4 VCC (digital-logic supply pin) to GND

anomalies.impact: The SSD1306 VCC pin is left without a DC supply path (only a capacitor to ground), likely causing the display not to initialize or operate.

parsed.summary: The build shows two connectivity anomalies: the NFC field-detect net is merged with an antenna terminal, and the SSD1306 VCC power pin is not connected to the global VCC rail.
